newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's oil, gas exports up 29 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's oil, gas exports up 29 percent in 1996.

text.p: The value of Algeria's exports of oil and gas rose to $12.6 billion in 1996, up 29 percent from the year before, the country's state-owned oil and gas Sonatrach head said on Sunday.
Nazim Zouioueche was quoted by Algerian radio as telling a news conference in Algiers the rise was due to, among other things, improved efficiency and higher international oil prices.

He was quoted by the radio and the official Algerian news agency APS as saying Algeria earned an average of $21.6 per barrel in 1996. The government had budgeted an average of $16-$17 per barrel for 1996.
Algeria's oil and gas exports were worth about $9.8 billion in 1995 against $8.5 billion the previous year, according to official figures.
